overall_notes: The paper presents JAMDEC, an unsupervised authorship obfuscation method using constrained decoding over small LMs. It evaluates on authorship obfuscation task using both automatic metrics (Drop Rate, METEOR, NLI, CoLA, Task Score, Perplexity) and human evaluation (5 criteria on 3-point Likert scale). The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization and removal of incorrect items for question 3.
